source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of multiple alleles (PDF 92-93).

blocks.text: Multiple allelic system tab hota hai jab aabadi mein kisi gene ki do se zyada mutabadil shaklein (alleles) hon, jis se khasiyat mein zyada tanawwu aata hai. Phir bhi har shakhs in mein se sirf do alleles rakhta hai.
Misaal insani ABO blood group system hai, jo aik gene (I gene) qaboo karta hai jis ke teen alleles hain: IA, IB aur i. In alleles ke mukhtalif jore chaar blood groups banate hain.

blocks.caption: ABO blood groups aur un ke genotypes

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: ABO system mein alleles IA aur IB co-dominance bhi dikhate hain. Mendel ke matar mein har khasiyat aik do allele wale gene se qaboo hoti thi, aik doosre par poora dominant; incomplete dominance aur co-dominance is qaide par nahi chalte, aur multiple allelic system mein gene ke do se zyada alleles hote hain jin mein se koi do mil kar phenotype banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Teen ABO alleles se kitne mukhtalif genotypes mumkin hain?
blocks.explanation: Chhe: IA IA, IA i, IB IB, IB i, IA IB aur i i, jo chaar phenotypes (A, B, AB, O) dete hain.

items: Multiple alleles: aabadi mein do se zyada alleles, har shakhs mein do.
ABO: IA, IB, i; chhe genotypes, chaar groups.
